subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 12,000 in 3 years at a rate of 10% per annum, compounded annually.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 12,000

Rate of interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + R/100)T - P

**Calculation:**

CI = 12000 × (1 + 10/100)³ - 12000

CI = 12000 × (1 + 0.1)³ - 12000

CI = 12000 × (1.1)³ - 12000

CI = 12000 × 1.331 - 12000

CI = 15972 - 12000

CI = 3972

**The compound interest on Rs. 12,000 in 3 years at a rate of 10% per annum, compounded annually is Rs. 3972.**
